# Where to Watch All Is Merry & Bright


by Angel | November 19, 2026


Between decorating the house, preparing Christmas dinner, wrapping presents, and getting everyone together, the holidays can feel like a lot of work. And when family dynamics get thrown into the mix, even the best-laid Christmas plans can go hilariously wrong.


That’s exactly what happens in *All Is Merry & Bright* , a heartwarming holiday comedy about one family’s attempt to have the perfect Christmas.


If you’re looking for a funny, wholesome Christmas movie with plenty of heart and a meaningful message about family and faith,[watch All Is Merry & Bright on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/all-is-merry-bright)


### **When Christmas Plans Go Hilariously Wrong**


Jessica Tannen has one goal: give her family the perfect Christmas. With what may be their last holiday all together, she wants to make every moment count.


There’s just one problem. Nothing is going according to plan.


Her to-do list keeps growing, a sibling rivalry is reigniting, extended family members arrive earlier than expected, and a mischievous dog adds even more trouble to the mix. Before long, Jessica’s dream of a picture-perfect holiday turns into a comedy of Christmas mishaps.


The result is a story full of familiar family moments and laugh-out-loud situations. Whether you’ve experienced the stress of hosting holiday guests or watched a simple family gathering turn into complete chaos, you’ll probably recognize a little of your own Christmas traditions in this one.


As one IMDb reviewer put it, “It felt like I was dropped into a picture of my own family.”


### **Rediscover the True Meaning of Christmas**


Alongside its comedy and family moments, *All Is Merry & Bright* brings faith into the heart of its story. As Jessica’s plans begin to unravel, the movie offers a meaningful reminder of what matters most during the Christmas season: love, faith, and the people we share our lives with.


Angel Guild members especially appreciated the movie’s Christian message. One reviewer called it a “perfect combination of comedy and message,” while another praised it as a great family Christmas movie that actually talks about Christ.


It’s the kind of holiday story that offers more than seasonal entertainment. It creates an opportunity to reflect on the reason we celebrate Christmas in the first place.


### **Watch** ***All Is Merry & Bright*** **on Angel**


Gather your loved ones, grab some popcorn, and get ready for a holiday comedy filled with laughter, faith, and plenty of Christmas chaos.
